--- GymTimerProUITests/GymTimerProUITests.swift
+++ GymTimerProUITests/GymTimerProUITests.swift
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
 import UIKit
 import XCTest
+import StoreKitTest
+import StoreKit
 
 final class GymTimerProUITests: XCTestCase {
 
@@ -365,6 +367,7 @@
     private func launchApp(_ options: LaunchOptions) -> XCUIApplication {
         let app = XCUIApplication()
         setupSnapshot(app)
+        app.launchArguments += ["-AppleLanguages", "(es)", "-AppleLocale", "es_ES"]
         app.launchArguments += ["ui-testing"]
         app.launchArguments += ["-purchase.cachedIsPro", options.isPro ? "1" : "0"]
 
@@ -434,3 +437,52 @@
         }
     }
 }
+
+extension GymTimerProUITests {
+    @MainActor
+    func testAdditionalPremiumSpanishCaptures() async throws {
+        let session = try SKTestSession(configurationFileNamed: "GymTimerPro")
+        session.disableDialogs = true
+        session.resetToDefaultState()
+        session.clearTransactions()
+        let transaction = try await session.buyProduct(identifier: "premium_yearly")
+        XCTAssertNil(transaction.revocationDate)
+        XCTAssertTrue((transaction.expirationDate ?? .distantPast) > Date())
+        func verifyLocalPremium(_ screen: String) {
+            XCTAssertTrue(session.allTransactions().contains {
+                $0.productIdentifier == "premium_yearly" && $0.state == .purchased
+            })
+            print("PREMIUM_PROOF \(screen): active premium_yearly local StoreKit transaction; cachedIsPro launch override = false")
+        }
+        func attach(_ name: String, _ screenshot: XCUIScreenshot) {
+            let attachment = XCTAttachment(screenshot: screenshot)
+            attachment.name = name
+            attachment.lifetime = .keepAlways
+            add(attachment)
+        }
+        let editorApp = launchApp(LaunchOptions(isPro: false, resetRoutines: true))
+        XCTAssertTrue(editorApp.staticTexts["Pro"].waitForExistence(timeout: 20))
+        verifyLocalPremium("editor home")
+        openTab(at: 1, in: editorApp)
+        let fullBody = editorApp.staticTexts["Full Body"]
+        XCTAssertTrue(fullBody.waitForExistence(timeout: 10))
+        fullBody.tap()
+        XCTAssertTrue(editorApp.buttons["Guardar"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10))
+        XCTAssertEqual(editorApp.textFields["Nombre"].value as? String, "Full Body")
+        XCTAssertFalse(editorApp.keyboards.firstMatch.exists)
+        verifyLocalPremium("12_RoutineEditor")
+        attach("12_RoutineEditor", editorApp.screenshot())
+        editorApp.terminate()
+
+        let completedApp = launchApp(LaunchOptions(sets: 4, restSeconds: 90, currentSet: 4, isPro: false))
+        XCTAssertTrue(completedApp.staticTexts["Pro"].waitForExistence(timeout: 20))
+        verifyLocalPremium("completed home immediately before completion")
+        let finish = completedApp.descendants(matching: .any)["startRestButton"]
+        XCTAssertTrue(finish.waitForExistence(timeout: 10))
+        finish.tap()
+        XCTAssertTrue(completedApp.staticTexts["¡ENTRENAMIENTO COMPLETADO!"].waitForExistence(timeout: 1))
+        attach("05_TrainingCompleted", completedApp.screenshot())
+        verifyLocalPremium("05_TrainingCompleted")
+        completedApp.terminate()
+    }
+}
